steps.t: Reach the wreckage in the Formicai Hills
steps.go: Head to the Formicai Hills in the southern woods of Dam Battlegrounds and look for the huge half-buried spider-like ARC wreck in a clearing.

steps.t: Search for the missing helmet
steps.pin: Keeping the Memory - Find the Helmet
steps.go: Follow the wire trail away from the wreck and check the base of the small bush near its end.

steps.t: Return the helmet to the memorial
steps.pin: Keeping the Memory - Return the Helmet to the Memorial
steps.go: The memorial is the metal pole stuck in the ground a few steps away; interact with it to set the helmet on top.

steps.t: Reach the Formicai Outpost
steps.go: Go to the Formicai Hills in the south of Dam Battlegrounds and climb the zig-zag plank trail up to the outpost tower.

steps.t: Find the Raider Flag
steps.pin: A Symbol Of Unification - Locate The Flag
steps.go: Enter through the dark ground-floor corridor, turn right and loot the yellow bag lying on the medical bed.

steps.t: Hoist the Raider Flag
steps.pin: A Symbol Of Unification - Hoist The Flag
steps.go: Cross the round central room and step out onto the balcony facing Red Lake; use the flagpole on your left.

steps.t: Search for Major Aiva's mementos in the apartments northwest of the Dam
steps.go: Go to Ruby Residence northwest of the Dam, enter the westernmost of the three blocks and climb to the top indoor floor, not the roof. The mementos are on a table by a big square window.

steps.t: Deliver Major Aiva's Mementos to Tian Wen
steps.go: Stash the mementos in your safe pocket, extract, then hand them to Tian Wen in Speranza.

steps.t: Retrieve Celeste's Journal from the South Swamp Outpost
steps.go: Head to the outpost on the southern edge of the swamp on Dam Battlegrounds and search inside for the journal.

steps.t: Retrieve Celeste's Journal from the northern outpost overlooking the Red Lakes
steps.go: Make for the northern outpost above the Red Lakes and sweep the interior and raised platforms for the second journal.

steps.t: Deliver the Journals to Celeste
steps.go: Extract with both journals, ideally one in your safe pocket, and hand them to Celeste in Speranza.

steps.t: Loot a Baron Husk
steps.go: Find the giant spider-shaped ARC shell west of Water Treatment Control toward South Swamp Outpost, climb a leg onto it and breach the centre. Back off while it burns, then climb up and loot the core for the ARC Powercell.

steps.t: Install a LiDAR Scanner at the top of the Control Tower
steps.pin: LiDAR Scanner on the Control Tower
steps.go: At the Control Tower south of the Dam's centre, breach the lift shaft past the locked Dam Staff Room, deal with the turrets and zip up. Walk out onto the roof and use the tripod in the east corner.

steps.t: Install a LiDAR Scanner at the Communications Tower
steps.pin: LiDAR Scanner at the Communications Tower
steps.go: On Spaceport, climb the ladder at the Communications Tower on the east side and walk round the platform to the tripod.

steps.t: Install a LiDAR Scanner on top of the Galleria sign
steps.pin: LiDAR Scanner on the Galleria sign
steps.go: On Buried City, get onto the Galleria roof, cross the planks on the south-east side and zipline up the sign pillar to the tripod.

steps.t: Locate the Possibly Toxic Plant at the Baron Husk
steps.go: Go to Old Battleground on the far west of Dam Battlegrounds and search around the huge Baron Husk for a plant with bright orange blooms; gather it and pick up the drop.

steps.t: Deliver the plant to Lance
steps.go: Put the plant in your safe pocket, extract via the nearby lift and hand it to Lance in Speranza.

steps.t: Photograph the goal
steps.go: At the Water Towers on Dam Battlegrounds, stand by the wooden football goal in front of the football-painted dome until the photo prompt shows.

steps.t: Find a Bicycle Pump
steps.go: Check the container by the bike leaning on the dome wall near the goal. A guaranteed spawn also sits at the bike outside the Marano Station kiosk on Buried City.

steps.t: Find a Deflated Football
steps.go: Open the small metal box in the grass behind the goal, between it and the nearest water tower.

steps.t: Photograph the football magazines at a kiosk
steps.go: On Buried City, go to the open newspaper kiosk at the north end of Marano Station, step inside and photograph the magazines.

steps.t: Deliver a Deflated Football and a Bicycle Pump to Apollo
steps.go: Extract with both items and hand them to Apollo in Speranza.
